items.brief: WSJ full-page ad targets SEC exemption for tokenized securities venues
items.why: Signals industry pushback on regulatory exemptions enabling tokenized stock trading.

items.brief: Polygon and Solana partner to bring stablecoin payments to banks
items.why: Shows interoperability between networks for stablecoin settlement in banking.

items.brief: Canton Strategic Holdings plans tokenized stock trading from Nov. 2
items.why: Adds regulated, round-the-clock tokenized equities under the SEC innovation exemption.

items.brief: Bank of England consults on tokenized collateral for clearing
items.why: Central counterparties would need to show tokenized collateral meets liquidity and risk tests.
